testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between a drawing and a part being edited: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-tabs-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:160:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between a drawing and a part being edited ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` and `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` are open ✔ And the user edits Sketch1 in the part, activates the drawing and collapses its drawing resources branch ✔ When the user selects the part document tab ✔ Then the part sketch viewport and model browser are displayed ✔ And the sketch ribbon is active ✔ When the user selects the drawing document tab ✔ Then the drawing sheet and drawing browser are displayed ✔ And the drawing ribbon is active ✔ And the drawing resources branch is collapsed ✔ And the part remains available as an open tab ✔ When the user selects the part document tab again ✔ Then the part sketch viewport and model browser are displayed ✔ And the sketch editing environment remains active
